next.reason: 1985: 'There are five categories of data ... alphabetic, numeric, alphanumeric, alphanumeric edited, and numeric edited.'; 2023: 'alphabetic — alphanumeric — alphanumeric-edited — boolean — national — national-edited — numeric — numeric-edited'. 2023 extends the PICTURE categories from five to eight by adding boolean, national and national-edited, so pictures such as N or 1 now define valid items.
